premises.text: Paper batteries based on hydrogel-reinforced cellulose with zinc and manganese replace conventional chemistries

premises.text: Design is compostable, mechanically adaptive, safe when damaged, and manufacturable on existing lines

premises.text: Material abundance drives an order-of-magnitude cost reduction versus incumbents
